Women Protest Unpaid Dues Under Annapurna Yojana

Women in Bengal have taken to the streets to protest unpaid dues related to the Annapurna Yojana, months after its launch. In one instance, BJP workers locked a panchayat office over the outstanding payments. The protests indicate a spread of discontent over the dues.
